ARITHMETIC INCONSISTENCY on the form, kept verbatim: Line 5 (54,041.91) is not Line 3 + Line 4 (which would be 71,378.09) - it equals Line 4 minus Line 3, as though the 8,668.09 beginning balance were negative; no minus sign is printed. Lines 6/7 are internally consistent with Line 5. Line 2 Column A is blank; the expenditure figure is only in Column B.

contributions.detail: exact (p3 21,295.00 + p4 41,415.00 = 62,710.00 = the attachment's own printed grand total $62,710.00 = stated 62,710.00)

expenditures.detail: the Summary Page's Line 2 COLUMN A was left BLANK by the filer, so there is no stated period total to reconcile against. The transcribed rows sum to 21,943.91, which equals BOTH the Schedule B attachment's own printed 'Total 21,943.91' AND the Summary Page's Line 2 Column B figure of 21,943.91. Recorded as unknown because the contracted anchor (Column A) is blank, not because the sum is in doubt.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 and p4 print no per-page subtotal (custom spreadsheet); the single printed grand total $62,710.00 sits at the foot of p4 and the two pages' rows sum to it exactly - gate fires at the schedule level. p5 prints 'Total 21,943.91' and its 28 rows sum to 21,943.91 exactly - gate fires.
itemized.escalation_note: p3, p4 and p5 re-rendered at 300 dpi and rotated 90 CCW with PIL to make the landscape attachments readable (the 200 dpi portrait render is unreadable); p5 additionally rendered at 90 CW
itemized.notes: THIS FILING'S SCHEDULES ARE NOT THE PRE-PRINTED FORM - the filer attached his own LANDSCAPE SPREADSHEET for both schedules ('Attach additional pages or your own spreadsheet if needed'), so the column set differs from the standard form. CONSEQUENCES: (1) SCHEDULE A HAS NO DATE COLUMN AT ALL - its columns are Last / First / Address / City / State / Zip / Occupation and Employer / Contributed. Every contribution date is therefore blank BY SOURCE and every contribution row carries needs_review=1 for that missing field; this is a real absence, not an unreadable cell. (2) The Address / City / State / Zip columns are printed but ENTIRELY EMPTY on both Schedule A pages - the filer supplied no geography, so donor_city and donor_state are blank (filer-blank, not a county redaction; this document is not from the redacted series). (3) The spreadsheet prints the name/occupation halves of each row on two slightly OFFSET grids, which reads at first glance like a one-row field shift. The field-shift screen was run and CLEARS: 36 names against 36 amounts on p3 and 20 against 20 on p4, and the row correspondence is confirmed semantically at many points (Gaskill William / 'Newreach, Inc., President' directly under the separate 'Newreach, inc' corporate row; Bradley Jim / 'Salt Lake County Councilman'; Corroon Peter / 'S.L. County Mayor'; Hatch Jeffrey / 'Salt Lake County Auditor'; Gardner Kem / 'Gardner Development, President'; Horiuchi Randy / 'Candidate' against the $30,000 Loan). (4) The last two Schedule A rows carry a label in an UNLABELLED column right of Contributed: 'Loan' beside the candidate's own $30,000.00 and 'in kind' beside Love Communications' $5,000.00 - the latter is recorded in_kind=true. (5) Donor names are stored surname-first as the spreadsheet prints them (Last then First), joined with a space. (6) Schedule B (p5) DOES carry a date column and its own printed Total.
